newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Moeller ups ship order.
newsitem.headline: Danish Moeller ups ship order.

text.p: Danish shipping and energy group A.P. Moeller(APM) said on Wednesday it ordered a further three of what it said are the world's largest container ships for its Maersk Line from its wholly-owned Odense Steel Shipyard in central Denmark.

The three billion crown order for the three 85,000-tonne dwt vessels, each with a capacity of 6,000 20 ft (six metre) containers, was due for delivery in 1999, Moeller's information department told Reuters.
The Odense shipyard has already delivered four of an original order for 12 of the container vessels with the remaining eight ships due for completion in 1997 and 1998, Moeller said.
The vessels are 318 metres (1,043 ft) long, a shade longer than the height of Paris' Eiffel Tower, with advanced computer controls and a crew of only 15.
